verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own AI assistant, but it is scoped to answering questions about the Pomelo API in the developer docs. There is no evidence of an assistant inside the operational product (e.g., the Dashboard) that can take on and execute tasks. The MCP server and natural-language API access belong to a separate external-agent story and are not credited here. missing for 10: an in-product (Dashboard) assistant, task delegation/execution rather than Q&A, documentation of its capabilities and scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
